Dust and fiber grayscale masks
==============================
Creator: Daniela Ivanova
Work: Scans of film damage
Source: https://doi.org/10.6084/m9.figshare.21803292
Licence: Creative Commons Attribution 4.0 International (CC BY 4.0)
https://creativecommons.org/licenses/by/4.0/

112 masks were derived from Scan (1), (4), (8), (9) and (10):
64 dust particles, 32 short fibers and 16 long fibers. Changes: grayscale
crops, local median background removal, MAD-based noise floor, per-mask
P99 normalization, contour feathering and uniform resampling into 64x64
padded tiles. Individual masks retain source aspect ratio. These edits
are artistic extraction choices, not calibrated optical density data.
The dataset creator does not endorse this application.

The original scan/annotation identifiers and extraction geometry are in
engine/third_party/film_damage_simulator/dust_assets.json in this application's
corresponding source. The masks are there in dust_masks/. The baked engine
atlas is generated by engine/tools/bake_dust_atlas.py and requires no Python
or external reference directory at runtime.

The simulation still approximates neutral attenuation using the existing
negative/print/scanner path, rather than a measured scanner-specific model.
FilmDamageSimulator's algorithm reference code is separately MIT licensed.
